purpose: The common scientific reference for integration tests, performance figures, screenshots, the live demo and exported evidence (product spec 6, implementation spec 14.2).
sites_status: PLACEHOLDER. These are the RUN-001 rule points, not verified candidate sites. GR-001 cannot be frozen until the science owner chooses three sites with coordinate and terrain provenance (SDR-001 D-09).

selection_reasons.mission.start_utc: 2027-01-10 00:00 UTC, the round date already used by the recorded fixtures and RUN-001, inside the kernel, Horizons and DEM coverage; fixed before looking at any result (S-11, D-08). Not chosen to contain or avoid an outage.
selection_reasons.mission.duration_s: seven days, the scenario length used throughout
selection_reasons.requirements: scenario values (Sun 60 %, Earth 50 %), not mission rules
selection_reasons.terrain: primary DEM release recommended in D-01, 150 km radius, 0.1 deg azimuth step (D-05), 2 m mast

freeze_rule: Once frozen, this file is never edited. Any change to provider settings, observer conventions, DEM identity, horizon parameters, event policy or algorithm version gives a new run_id and must become GR-002.
